steward_observed_before_fix.source: PR #16 comment 6102785527; snapshot JSON not transferred

cause: API mapped projection status not_initialized to HTTP 503 while the browser polled the optional relation unconditionally; the UI treated each valid missing-relation response as request failure.
correction: Missing optional relation returns HTTP 200 with explicit status=not_initialized; browser skips endpoint polling until status reports the relation present; actual database query failures continue returning HTTP 503.
